title: Surreal Garden Terrarium
description: A surreal scene featuring a large cracked orange sun radiating over a tiled pathway leading to a transparent spherical terrarium. Inside the glowing purple terrarium are green lizard-like creatures, swirling patterns, bubbles, and a small white cat on top. The pathway is bordered by oversized blue and orange flowers, green vines, and industrial-looking tower structures under a gradient sky.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic garden scene with a giant cracked orange sun shining above.
